criteria.text: Given the toggle is on and a push has changes, When I push interactively, Then the wall ASKs and shows the changed files with added and removed counts
Given the run is non-interactive (a CI marker is set), When a push happens, Then the diff review does not fire
Given the dev sets diffReviewBeforePush false, When they push, Then the diff review does not fire
Given a push with nothing to show, When it runs, Then the diff review does not fire
Given a non-push command, When it runs, Then the diff review does not fire
Given a numstat with many files, When the summary is formatted, Then it lists the largest changes and truncates
